name: Rhett Good
text: Love Teamwork Bloomington. I have been a member for 2 years and they have definitely gotten me on a healthier path. Highly recommend Teamwork for anyone looking to get healthier. Trainers have a good feel for teaching correct movements. My entire family now works out here.

name: Angela Lindauer
text: I am not a member but both of my children are members. They work out between 2-4 times a week here. The staff is fabulous and supportive. They want to see the athletes develop not only as an athlete but also as a human being. My kids love this place and I am so happy we made the decision to sign them up.

name: Chris Parker
text: I originally joined Teamwork for a 60 day weight loss challenge, but I've been coming back for almost a year and a half now. Whatever your goals, be it weight loss, strength training, speed training, or general athleticism, Teamwork will help you set attainable goals for sustainable growth. Thanks Erin, Rod, Seth, Jordan, and Lauren!

name: Jason
text: Was a multi-sport athlete who LOVED hard workouts in high school. Joined the armed services and started to dislike any type of workout… 16 years after leaving high school I FINALLY found a gym that brought my love of working out back! Teamwork Bloomington is a fantastic gym with OUTSTANDING trainers, diverse workouts, and a holistic view to better health. 18+ months later at 37yrs old, I'm 40+lbs down, my nutrition is much better, and I still love the workouts. Even my 10yr old loves the workouts and sees continued improvement in her athletic coordination. Come check them out!!!

name: Torlando Hakes
text: At the beginning of the year my wife joined TeamWork and as a family we started the nutrition plan (whole30) encouraged by Rod and Erin… I dropped around 20 lbs and eliminated the severe heart burn that kept me up at night… I see people of all ages and walks of life come in to train at TeamWork and we all seem so happy to be there. Rod and Erin are very genuine and friendly. And I'm really in the best shape of my life because of them.

name: Dr. Kevin Moore
text: Teamwork is an amazing place for both youth athletes as well as adults who care about their fitness, strength and vitality. The coaching staff is amazing and the facility has the vibe of family while the workouts are tough but leave you feeling very accomplished. I highly recommend Teamwork Bloomington!

name: Timothy Adams
text: The coaches here make all the difference. They provide good guidance on proper form and client-specific recommendations on how to fix injuries/weaknesses… This is a great place to escape from being a "gym rat" and actually train to just be stronger or for sport-specific performance.

name: Marco Fitch
text: I went to teamwork from about 6th grade until I left for college basketball after high school and highly recommend the gym, staff, and owners to any athletes or adults that want to change their fitness and lives. I made countless friends I would consider family and was more than prepared for a college weight room after I left.

name: Gavin Reed
text: Seth and the rest of the staff are extremely knowledgeable in all aspects of your body and your health! The change I saw in my athletic ability was nothing short of amazing. I have felt quicker, more athletic, and stronger all in the span of a few months. I highly recommend spending your time training here!

name: Greg Winston
text: Teamwork Bloomington is a great facility with great leadership and athletic knowledge behind their training… Rod Root's programs took my lacrosse performance to new heights and were the reason for basically all my athletic accomplishments.

name: Dr. Brandon Applegate
text: The coaches at Teamwork Bloomington are experts in improving the performance of youth athletes in the Bloomington area. Their endless pursuit to provide tailored and evidence informed training solutions to their athletes is what sets them apart… If you are a parent of a youth athlete looking to help your kid improve their confidence, self-efficacy, and performance in their sport, I highly recommend getting your kid started at Teamwork!

name: Beau King
text: Rod and team are top notch! I've trained at Teamwork for years and I recommend them to all my friends/family.

name: Andrea Meyer
text: Teamwork is such a great environment for young athletes. When my son was training there he was always encouraged and the culture of safety is appreciated.

name: Rebecca Ball
text: Great program for my athlete. Has helped him gain strength and speed in his sport. Highly recommend great staff.
